question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Final answer: just the problem names where exceed_count > solution_count
WITH solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
),
exceed_counts AS (
    SELECT ms.name, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN non_stack_max_score < stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as exceed_count
    FROM (
        SELECT ms2.name, ms2.version, ms2.step, 
               MAX(CASE WHEN ms2.model = 'Stack' THEN ms2.test_score END) as stack_score,
               MAX(CASE WHEN ms2.model != 'Stack' THEN ms2.test_score END) as non_stack_max_score
        FROM model_score ms2
        WHERE ms2.step IN (1, 2, 3)
        GROUP BY ms2.name, ms2.version, ms2.step
        HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN ms2.model = 'Stack' THEN ms2.test_score END) IS NOT NULL
    ) ms
    GROUP BY ms.name
)
SELECT sc.name
FROM solution_counts sc
JOIN exceed_counts ec ON sc.name = ec.name
WHERE ec.exceed_count > sc.solution_count
ORDER BY sc.name
